62746918
>>62746859
Since I am bored at work I will continue my rant.

All those people hoping or preparing for the printer. PEPP and QE are discontinued. So the ECB would have to set up a new program to do so. However, the situation is very different from the credit crisis or Corona. Inflation is high and the ECB has been tightening to keep it down. Setting up a new QE program right now just to keep French debt manageable would be an extremely stupid move.

I think the following options might be on the table:
1. TPI: if Lagarde starts talking about "irrational markets" and how monetary transfer is getting fucked this will be the next step
2. Extending cheap credit to French banks: right now the crisis is on the government balance sheet but if it starts hitting the banking system this could be on the table
3. ESM or OMT: when shit hits the fan and France remains in political paralysis this could be an option. However, its got a lot of strings attached going as far as a Troika (see Greece). Doubt the French would accept that. Honestly could result in a Frexit or something retarded like Melenchon "cancelling" French debt
4. Only when contagion happens and France drags the whole union down will QE be an option

The fact of the matter is that printing money would buy France some time but only reforms can put it on a sustainable path. The catch-22 is that printing will give a perverse incentive not to reform.
